text:
sara: quick follow-up from the postmortem — consolidating action items from the token validation incident. TL;DR: token expiry skew, missing audit events on the refresh path, and several service accounts with old keys. I put a short tracker draft here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-4532. Please ack and add ETA.

raj: ack, taking owner on token validation fix. plan: add strict expiry check + 5s skew tolerance and unit+integration tests. will open PR with test matrix by EOD Thu. staging window request: Fri 09:00-11:00 PT.

elaine: noted. I'll run an audit backfill for refresh events and add the missing event emission in the refresh handler. proposing retention policy: 365d for auth events. I'll drop the initial backfill query into the tracker.

mike: I'm on service-account key rotation sweep. running a dry-run to list keys >180d and compiling owners. automated rotation via krotator will be enabled; initial sweep targeted for 2026-04-02.

ops-jordan: will add a token-health alert to SRE. question: what's the intended severity and on-call escalation? Recommend severity: P2 (alerts if >0.5% invalid token rate over 5m). also need a short runbook link.

sara: severity P2 works. runbook draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/token-validation-runbook. add fallback steps: switch traffic to compatible model variant if validation service degrades.

raj: quick note — I ran into a failing case in integration where tokens with subsecond skews passed incorrectly. test snippet I added: ```py
assert validate_token(expiry_ts - 0.3) is False
```
I'll include that in CI.

elaine: backfill query (bigquery): ```sql
SELECT * FROM `prod.audit.events` WHERE event_type = 'token_refresh' AND timestamp BETWEEN TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP();
```
I'll attach results to the ticket and mark rows lacking refresh_event:true.

mike: dry-run output (sample): `service-account:infra-batch, key_id: ak_9b2, age_days: 214` — I'll rotate these first and send a PR to update owner tags.

ops-jordan: created alert in Datadog: token.validation.error_rate > 0.5% for 5m -> notify #oncall + paged. runbook linked in alert.

oncall-bot: created issue SEC-4532 and linked PRs; added assignees: raj, elaine, mike, ops-jordan; deadlines set to 2026-04-05 for core fixes.

sara: thanks — please update the tracker with precise PR links and change logs. we'll review in Fri's postmortem follow-up slot (standup 10:30 PT). :thumbsup:
